quote: I want to participate in the deeper work. I have come home.
name: Tom V.

quote:
Dear organizing team,

Thank you for allowing us—Peter M., Jeanette M., and Sophie M.—to be part of the gathering with the facilitator last night. We cherish this experience and feel deep gratitude.

I want to share with you just how special this evening was for our Sophie, as a way of thanking you for the enormous effort you all put into organizing this.

The past few years have been very difficult for our family. Sophie has not had an easy time. She was the reason we started systemic therapy with a doctor specialized in healing the inner child. This doctor is psychically gifted and sees blockages created by the ego that have become blind spots, spots that prevent you from living from your true self and connecting with the Source.

Sophie is our mirror child and has brought deep traumas in Peter and me to the surface, originating, among other things, from a toxic family system involving narcissism. These traumas, in turn, also wounded her. Intergenerational trauma.

For us as parents, this has been an extremely painful process, but at the same time cleansing and liberating.

One of Sophie's wishes in working with this doctor was to restore her connection with the Source, which had become closed off. We have worked very hard on this.

She had difficulty feeling. For a while, she completely lost her way. There was an eating disorder, and we even wondered about other challenges.

All of this began to transform when Peter and I started looking at our own traumas. She was only mirroring them.

Some time ago, Sophie expressed that she wanted to heal more deeply, because she could still feel a blockage within herself.

Sophie is not an average teenager. She can follow the facilitator's explanations and understands so much more than I do sometimes. She explains complex spiritual content to me and was already doing this when she was very young.

Then a friend came onto our path. We have known her for a long time, but for a while we had less contact. The friend spoke about Sri AmmaBhagavan. She led us to you.

Last night was so special.

Suddenly, Sophie was functioning from her heart. She was liberated. That part of her had been closed.

As her mother, this makes me very emotional—to see her like this. I feel so much gratitude.

Sophie was able to peel away several layers and transform old pain and sadness. She had never been able to do that before.

This morning, she was dancing around the house. So free. So full of feeling.

A miracle.

The facilitator broke right through it.

THANK YOU.

Peter and I are not there yet. We are still struggling with parts of the ego. We still have some work to do.

Yesterday, however, was also very special for us.

I could experience that something was being worked on in me, around my neck. I think I felt the presence of divine love—an intensely warm, motherly love.

I received an image showing me that there is a great deal of pain and sadness within me.

It was confronting and painful to experience, but also very valuable. Time to do something with it.

Peter is currently going through a very difficult process involving deep fears. Facing resistance and overcoming fears is very difficult when you have had a difficult childhood.

You created a space filled with tangible love and safety, which enabled him to take further steps in this process.

Thank you for making these experiences possible for us.

We cherish this.
name: Jeanette M.

quote:
Dear organizing team leaders,

Thank you for the three-day course in August. I loved it. It felt like a turning point.

The past months were very challenging because of a loved one's health crisis and all the pain this touched within me. I had become completely disconnected—from myself, from the people around me, and from the Divine.

During the three-day course, the pain was seen and began to come out.

After last week, with the Full Moon Deeksha, Darshan, and two one-to-one transfers from the facilitator, the connection has returned. It feels steadier now. There is more flow, the pain is dissolving, and there is gratitude.

Thank you.
name: Georgette L.

quote:
I always find it difficult to put my experiences into words, but this time I really want to share a little more.

For almost twenty years, I have been caring for my parents, more or less continuously, responding to whatever was needed. I am their only daughter. My relationship with my mother has always been difficult. She was very dominant and often crossed my boundaries, and I spent my whole life resisting her. She is now eighty-five and physically very frail.

Since last weekend, during the facilitator's transmission, something has shifted in me. My resistance has simply disappeared. It is almost impossible to describe what that feels like.

I no longer make plans. I simply receive an impulse and follow it. Suddenly, there is no resistance in the outside world either. Today, I accomplished things that would normally have taken me weeks. Everything happened effortlessly. I was simply in the flow.

Everyone I met was incredibly helpful, compassionate, and open-hearted. I had never experienced anything like it. It felt as though the Great Compassionate Light was carrying out every action through me. I could physically feel their presence. I never imagined that something like this was possible.

My gratitude is beyond words. Thank you to every one of you, especially to my sister Catherine, whom I feel I have known across so many lifetimes, and to the facilitator. Experiencing the power of this field was only possible because of all of you. Thank you from the bottom of my heart.
name: Michaela R.

quote: A huge round of applause for the Peace Field team! What wonderful organization—the preparations, the loving guidance, and the delicious refreshments. Everything was arranged beautifully, and I felt so welcome. Thank you!
name: Julia H.

quote:
During the 1-on-1 session with the facilitator, I completely surrendered.

I felt the energy of the Great Compassionate Light taking over my whole body. I came back, but I came back changed.

I felt different. Silent, peaceful, happy, loving.

It felt as if I was seeing everything through different eyes.

And even now, this beautiful state within me hasn't changed.

Thank you to everyone who made this beautiful experience possible.
name: Marcus P.

quote:
Dear organizing team, dear facilitator, dear Peace Field team,

First of all I would like to express my gratitude to you all. Thank you for allowing me to be at Peace Field, and thank you for the love.

As soon as I arrived in your sacred space, I felt great joy, the unique energy of the place, and the presence of the Divine. During the facilitator's transmissions, I felt complete calm, stillness, and peace within me. It felt as though I had been lifted out of the world.

It was difficult to say goodbye, but the joy of returning helped me. No journey to visit you is too long for me. We arrived home happy, full of love, and deeply nourished by everything we had experienced. I feel profoundly connected to you all.
name: Peter G.

quote:
As I entered Peace Field and sat down, I felt Grace coming over me and everyone present. Soma came into my throat and tasted sweet. I had experienced this before, but there had always been some doubt. This time it was stronger and undeniable. I began to cry with gratitude for the Grace of being there and being part of it, while my body laughed strangely through the tears.

I saw and felt Sri AmmaBhagavan within me, surrounded by brightness, and the message was clear: "This is what we have been working towards." I felt spiritual energy in my lower back expand. That cool glow had begun during the three-day course.

When the facilitator began, I felt such gratitude for him being present and sharing this with us. More laughing and crying arose. When it was my turn, I can only describe it as the facilitator and me being laughed through. So much more happened for which I have no words. My body loved it too and moved spontaneously. There was great joy. In the afternoon, I felt quieter and truly full.

When I saw Sri Bhagavan on Saturday, I burst with joy. It is going to happen for all of us! I also felt so much joy during the sharings. These people had made it, and it felt as though I—as though we—were part of them and had made it too.

The next day, I attended the unexpected funeral of a beloved family member. I felt their sweetness and gentleness very present in the church. I hugged all my relatives, overwhelmed by love, and whispered to two of them how much I loved them. It simply happened.

The inner child who feels hurt for the strangest reasons, the stress, and the chaos are still there—but now the glow and the gratitude are there too. Thank you, facilitator, for this beautiful gift. Thank you, dear organizing team members, and everyone who was there, for this beautiful field of love and connection. Thank you, Sri AmmaBhagavan, the Great Compassionate Light, and the spiritual teachers.
name: Naomi K.

quote: I recognize that silence from the session—a deeply fulfilling silence.
name: Gundi B.

quote:
Dear all, the week passed so quickly, and I am still connected with the beautiful energy of Peace Field. There is a vast space within me filled with warm, bright light—so gentle yet powerful, so loving and peaceful.

I am deeply grateful for all the gifts the Great Compassionate Light and Sri AmmaBhagavan gave me. It is beyond words. Everything was perfect. Dear organizing team members and facilitator, and the whole beautiful team, thank you so much for your immense love and service. With all my love.
name: Franca D.

quote:
Once you step into Peace Field, the process starts.

The presence of the Great Compassionate Light and Sri AmmaBhagavan is everywhere. The service volunteers seem to float while they prepare the space and settle every detail with so much love and care.

Each word from the organizing leader is filled with love and joy. The facilitator's appearance is already special. His sharing is open, joyful, wise, and clear enough for us to understand his state.

In this context, nothing wrong can happen. Grace and love are everywhere.

I attended twice this Friday.

During the first transfer, there was a mix of sadness and joy inside me, like the first time I went to India. Tears and tears, and then laughing and laughing. At the end, I already felt a shift, some soft peace in the brain, like a shutdown.

But during the second transfer, I was totally taken over. There was no "I" laughing without stopping. There was only laughter. The body was laughing, and the "I" was just witnessing. Some lovely hands helped me to move on, as I couldn't do it by myself, nor could I stop laughing for I don't know how long.

After the session, I felt that my brain had become empty. There was something like a hole in it. It was very difficult to talk at the beginning. I couldn't share the experience at the end when we were asked to.

After two days, I can feel there is a shift inside. There is a buffer space between the thoughts and what is happening outside, and I can see the automatic flowing of events...

Words will never be enough to express what is happening in Peace Field.

The Great Compassionate Light and Sri AmmaBhagavan has settled here in this place in Europe, and we are immensely fortunate to experience this field of love and joy.

Infinite and eternal gratitude to the organizing team, the facilitator, the service volunteers who made this possible, and all the participants for sharing this field of Grace together.
name: Ineke S.

quote:
My heartfelt thanks to the facilitator, the organizing team, and the musician for the deeply moving music. It was a beautiful and intense experience.

During the first session, I did not feel very much. But that evening, as I reviewed the day and returned inwardly to the moment when I sat before the facilitator, I felt his energy very strongly again. For about an hour, powerful vibrations moved through me, and afterwards my heart chakra felt open and free.

During the second session, the vibrations began immediately. I am deeply grateful.
name: Annemie W.

quote:
How BLESSED we are to have the opportunity to "meet the Light" through the facilitator and grow in consciousness.

As a service volunteer at Peace Field, I had four opportunities to receive the 1-on-1 transfer, which is difficult to describe in words.

Especially the fourth session, after Sri Bhagavan's wonderful Darshan, was extremely powerful and very special for me.

It all started as soon as the facilitator entered the hall and sat right behind me. I was sitting on a meditation cushion and immediately felt the Kundalini rising.

After the transfer, we integrated for some time and the body expanded. The sense of self was gone, thoughts were gone; there was only a huge, vast, pleasant energy field.

When the organizing leader asked us to open our eyes, it took some time to come back. When I looked down, I saw that a precious item was missing.

A fellow participant said, "It must be here!" We searched for it, but I went out to look in another area, where I had been before.

As soon as I left, another team member signalled to me that the fellow participant had found the precious item. This was a huge miracle, since I had been running around Peace Field for those two days.

Thanking the Divine, I remembered Sri Bhagavan saying to me in a private Darshan, "So you are from Belgium, then you must be precious."

I melted and tears came out of gratitude. Sri Bhagavan filled my heart and body instantaneously. The body was taken over completely by His Presence, and this feeling has still been there since that moment.

Something profound shifted in my heart! Thoughts are very few, mostly mantras. There is deep inner stillness, peace, and joy.

While receiving the 1-on-1 transfer, the body starts jumping and laughing like a happy little girl. The uncontrollable laughter stays afterwards, while lying down, for at least 15 minutes.

Now, four days later, the new state is still the same, so enjoyable.

How can we ever thank the Great Compassionate Light and Sri AmmaBhagavan and the facilitator enough for these special gifts?
name: Linda C.

quote:
I was touched by everything happening around me, yet what I felt most deeply was how difficult it is for me to connect with the Divine. I struggle with the image I hold but do not recognize, and I feel confused by the human form of Sri AmmaBhagavan.

I long for the deepest connection, yet I continue to feel unworthy. I also do not have earthly relationships that embody truly unconditional love for me. All of this was present.

Then a soft, tingling, pale-pink canopy of light appeared around me, flowing down from my head. It felt deeply soothing, and everything became a little quieter.
name: Pieter J.

quote:
Thank you so much for this beautiful experience, organizing team and facilitator, and your devotees.

It comes and it goes.
name: Sandra T.

quote:
I thank everyone for their presence, for the loving field we created together, the facilitator for his transmission, and the Peace Field team for making all of this possible.

During the Friday afternoon session, a deep silence opened within me...

During the fourth session, the energy was noticeably higher, and a lot of energy and warmth was released in my body. It felt wonderful to have everything flowing again.

I am grateful for the inner silence I experience, my open heart, and for everything that may still reveal itself after some more integration.

Grateful for the circle that connects us.
name: Hanne N.

quote:
I completely agree with Julia's testimonial. It was such a warm experience. The energy was powerful, and during the one-to-one sessions I feel sadness and pain being lifted from me, layer by layer. It is a privilege to experience this through the facilitator.

Thank you, thank you, organizing team and facilitator, the wonderful Peace Field team, and everyone who was present for this beautiful, transformative, and loving weekend.
name: Frederika B.

quote:
Everything was one great process of new insights and experiences in the actual growth of consciousness.

The facilitator embodied, experienced, and clearly demonstrated what it is like to live in the state of Oneness.

This breakthrough can now take place thanks to the Great Compassionate Light and Sri AmmaBhagavan, who are concretely present here with us!

Infinite gratitude to the Great Light within all of us that has made this possible.
name: Lisette O.

quote:
What an amazing experience... so powerful and special!

Thank you for allowing me to experience this!
name: Viera K.

quote:
I felt the very powerful energy, which I could receive and integrate effortlessly.

I was silence and complete peace.
name: Marcel V.

quote:
The day before the process with the facilitator, I faced a big charge in my private situation. Like always, I asked for spiritual liberation from it. But this time I could feel it wasn't gone.

Immediately, I thought that the timing was very good, because I expected the process with the facilitator to be more powerful than my individual spiritual practice.

So I asked the Divine for liberation and trusted the process.

During the process, as always, I didn't feel much. Only after the transmission, sitting on my chair, I felt a sudden deep sadness. Very briefly, but it felt like it came out.

Afterwards, I felt lots of sensations in my brain.

Today, the day after, I got a little headache—the first time after a process—but not too bad at all. The facilitator and the spiritual practice in one day were a bit much for me.

We planned a family day, but plans beautifully changed and I found time to rest and do spiritual practices already.

Now I'm doing well and very confident that everything was arranged perfectly by the Divine.

Thank you!
name: Robert H.

quote:
Thanks to the organizing team and the whole team, and especially to the facilitator for lending his body to the Great Compassionate Light so that it could spread out to everyone.

What an experience that was! I felt like I was flying on wings and melting with love for everybody. It was a beautiful session, and I can still feel that vibration throughout my whole body.

I feel very blessed and thankful that I could be there and receive this transfer, which certainly brought me into a higher consciousness.

Thank you so much for this special gift that I received. I'm very grateful.

Thanks also to the musician with his golden voice. It was so beautiful.

Thanks to everybody who could enjoy this fantastic gift. Thank you all for your warmth and love.
name: Dorothy E.

quote:
Dear everyone, dear organizing team, dear facilitator, dear musician,

Thank you for making it all possible. I'm very grateful for Peace Field existing.
name: Deirdre D.

quote:
Thank you, thank you for the laughter. I'm grateful for this feeling, for my inner silence, and for the love I feel for so many people.

Thank you, facilitator, organizing team, and service coordinator.
name: Ria W.

quote:
Thank you to dear organizing team, facilitator, and all service volunteers for a wonderful experience at Peace Field.

Thanks to all the people who contribute in so many ways to the smooth operation. Thank you all so much. Everyone was so loving.

I found the sacred altar at the entrance very powerful.

I was amazed by the fragrance of the Soma. It was divine. Was the fragrance really downloaded?

The facilitator's teaching was so very clear and powerful.

I was surprised by the way the facilitator was when the connection happened—it was wild. I was crying as the people went up, and the sound coming from me was different, maybe a child aching.

When it was my turn, it was like a fire of pain erupted along the insides of my two arms, from one wrist, across the chest, to the other wrist. It was so strong. I heard myself say, "Oh dear God."

It continued for a while. It was like ligaments, muscles, tendons—all on fire with unbearable pain. And then crying and deep, hard coughing. Afterwards, I felt normal and very good today.

I saw some healing of aspects of the wounded child from the three-day course that I had not seen before—times when I would have covered over pain arising in a conversation by saying something instead of nothing. A few times, I saw that I simply allowed it.

I saw myself edit a text—from one with a gossipy slant to a more integral one. And I saw a reduction in always wanting more and an increase in feeling satisfied. At the airport, I would usually want snacks and shops, but this was not there.

Also, the whole trip to Peace Field was a process. So many coincidences, miracles, insights, protections, and kindnesses.

During the video at Darshan, when a spiritual teacher told his disciples that the Avatar had taken birth on the planet, the facilitator bowed down. It touched my heart.

When Sri Bhagavan said, "There is no soul, there is no travelling," I still feel like I am real, but I am becoming a little bit conscious of thoughts.

And I liked when he spoke about suffering and the flowering of the heart. I have experienced this increase in love and feeling with some family members, and our relationships are so healed.

But often, I still use superficial pacifiers to avoid feeling their pain or my own pain.

All the time as I write this, the head is going—not only self, but still ego too.

Thank you all so much.
name: Mary A.

quote:
Dear organizing team and facilitator,

In April, after the session with the facilitator, I went to another location for a retreat with another spiritual teacher.

The combination of the facilitator's transfer and the other teacher's deeksha meant that after the first day I didn't know where I was, how I had gotten there, or that I had already been staying in an apartment for four days. I was super relaxed, felt wonderful, completely at ease, open and free from the mind, and in a state of bliss with laughter.

The memories returned the next day. The relaxed state of openness, thoughtlessness, and bliss remained for weeks.

I realized that I had received exactly what I had prayed for: Please liberate me from the ego, let my heart blossom open, and let the Divine work through my heart as Light and Love.

Great gratitude to the Great Compassionate Light, the facilitator, the organizing team, and the other spiritual teacher.
name: Ine T.

quote:
Thank you for the perfectly organized session with the facilitator and for the opportunity to receive this beautiful, high energy.

Absolutely fantastic.
name: Rombout F.

quote:
Thank you very, very much to all of you for making this very special weekend possible.

Thank you, organizing team and the whole team. Thank you, facilitator.

During the 1-on-1 transfers, I didn't feel so much. Afterward, while sitting on the chair, I once felt energy in my head and a sense of expansiveness—an unfolding that gradually spread in waves.

The second time, the sensation felt new and fresh, delicate and subtle as well, and then right at the very end, a very pleasant, soft, loving, "melting" sensation spread within and from my heart.

I'm very grateful for all.
name: Anna Maria Z.

quote:
Hello organizing team,

Just a few words about the Friday morning session.

It was a very beautiful experience. The Soma was nourishing and enlightening. The music was heavenly.

The 1-on-1 initially felt strange, but then, in surrender, I received the Divine Light and felt it flowing throughout my entire body. I felt warmth throughout my whole body.

In the evening, I felt very tired, but I had a very good feeling.

Thank you for this Divine experience.
name: Gerd G.

quote:
Thank you, dearest spiritual guides, dear facilitator, organizing team, and team, for this wonderful event. I was at Peace Field "only" for the Darshan and one transfer. It was wonderful to experience Darshan in a large group at this beautiful place.

What stood out most was the facilitator's guided meditation. I had the most wonderful experience with the Divine. The Soma felt as if it went straight into my brain, and the closing ritual at the end was deeply touching. In my heart, I fell to my knees.

At the end, I felt an intense urge to prostrate before the sacred altar, but I did not dare, and I felt sorry that I had not done it. The next morning at the hotel, I felt a strong need to say goodbye. I sang to the Divine 108 times in my heart, and felt and saw the Divine Presence there, immense and radiant. It was so sacred and moving. My bond feels so much more alive now. I feel blessed and grateful that I was able to be in this wonderful, sacred place.
name: Wiebke F.

quote:
Hi organizing team member,

Many thanks again for organizing everything. In the end, we only spoke briefly, which is understandable of course with all the organizing.

It was also very nice that you passed on both of my questions. I had expected a flood of questions from the participants, so I was pleasantly surprised that my questions were answered.

I experienced the energy as very light; I was mostly sitting there with a big smile.

It supports me in attuning to the Great Compassionate Light and reminds me to stay connected with it in daily life.
name: Wouter V.

quote:
Thank you all. It was beautiful and intense to take part in this. I experience gentleness, love, and attunement.

Thank you, facilitator. Thank you all for organizing this.

And thank you to my fellow participants for opening ourselves together, so that we can pass on what this awakens within us, allowing something beautiful to come into being in the world.
name: Anat S.

quote:
Dear, dear organizing team, Dear facilitator,

For me, it was like coming home, meeting my big spiritual family.

The power of the sessions is incredible!

The preparation with spiritual practice and later with the energy transfer was very powerful.

And when the facilitator starts transmitting to others, I feel the energy already moving my body in all directions—jumping, shaking, and making me laugh like a child.

So much joy.

I was lucky to participate three times.

The first two times, when sitting before the facilitator, the energy was so high, almost painful and blissful at the same time. The third time, there was only Light and bliss.

My head was very quiet on our way back home. I felt a lot of energy, even though it was quite late when we arrived home.

Today, I feel a lot of love and connection, and the feeling that everything is simply good as it is.

Life is just flowing, and we are being taken care of by the Great Compassionate Light and Sri AmmaBhagavan.

My heart is full of gratitude to the facilitator, to the organizing team, and to the whole beautiful Peace Field team for creating this Happening!!!

I really hope we can enjoy it again.
name: Karin P.

quote:
I am still in awe of what we received together. It was my first experience like this. The participants laughing together was already such a joyful experience, along with Sri Bhagavan's Darshan and the spiritual practice. It was also a powerful preparation.

The facilitator's transfer was very strong from the start. Even while I was sitting at the back, it lifted me into the air several times. I felt enormous gratitude and bliss that I could sit before the Great Compassionate Light flowing through the facilitator.

When it was my turn and I was guided forward, I already had difficulty walking. The helpers were very sweet. During the transfer, three extremely high jumps lifted me from the seat. I saw a bright light and heard myself utter an incredibly loud scream.

Afterwards, I could not walk at all. I remained in bliss for a long time. Even one day later, deep silence, gratitude, and trust are still within me—alongside many thoughts. Gratitude to the Divine.
name: Hannie U.

quote:
For us, Peace Field is a sacred temple: the love, cheerfulness, and safety are immediately felt from the very first step.

I experience the meeting and Q&A with the facilitator as full of humor and intelligence. He clearly explains what he has been through and what it is like to be in a Oneness state.

One condition: helplessness is something I don't feel. Is that an obstacle?

At the previous meeting, I experienced something mystical; this time, only love and bliss.

This makes me happier than, for example, a holiday to a resort. So not coming back when there is another opportunity is virtually not an option.

Thanks to the whole team, and especially the organizing leader and facilitator.
name: Margit R.

quote: Dear organizing team, facilitator, and team, thank you so much for everything. My cells feel replenished with Divine energy. My legs were trembling before and after the fourth session, yet during the transmission I felt calm within. Despite my health challenges, I found new confidence that I can overcome them. In deep connection.
name: Ann L.

quote:
I received another miraculous gift here.

Yesterday, while praying, I asked the Divine to please manifest Soma once again on my altar.

And just now I looked and—yes, oh yesssss!

So grateful.
name: Evangeline C.

quote:
During the spiritual meditation, the golden light quietly accumulated within me and rose upward like a cord until it burst out through my crown in great abundance, like a cannon. It just kept coming. Tears came from my eyes and my whole body was trembling. I felt enormously grateful.

During the meditation with the facilitator, when he told us to meditate to see our Divine, something incredibly special happened for me.

Above me flew three enormous angels with incredibly large wings: the first was my deceased mother, the second my deceased grandmother, and the third was a divine feminine presence.

Never before have I felt so protected and carried. Again, I was deeply grateful and profoundly touched, with tears in my eyes, but happy that I was allowed to see this.
name: Martine R.

quote:
Hey dear organizing team,

I waited a little before reaching out to you and telling you how I experienced everything.

Finding the right words isn't easy. For some of the sensations and experiences, I simply can't find the words.

It was the first time I experienced a 1-on-1 meeting with the facilitator.

Fortunately, some more experienced friends had told me a little about what to expect, because otherwise I might have left again. Not so much because of how the facilitator behaved, but mainly because of how some of the people present reacted. You, for example. Were you perhaps overwhelmed?

Some people were jumping, shaking, and so on. For someone who has never experienced this before, it is very impressive and can even be frightening.

Who would want to react in such an extreme way—or at least, that is how it seemed to me?

So I asked the Source of unconditional love to not let it happen to me like that.

And so it was.

Oh yes... The Soma was blissful! It made me so happy, like a joyful child, and I laughed so wonderfully.

I experienced the work on the spiritual energy centers as very powerful. At one point, I started feeling unwell and had to stop for a moment.

The loving transmission through the facilitator felt very, very special. For a brief moment, he made eye contact and—bang...

I described it to my friend as if a little star had been placed right at my core.

An enormous feeling of gratitude arose, together with deep emotion for what had been transmitted, although I cannot put into words exactly what it was.

Love is probably the best word for it.

On Saturday, I was at home when suddenly an image of the facilitator appeared before me. He greeted me, and once again I received a gentle energy filled with unconditional love.

This has become a long message, for which I apologize.

Am I glad I went? Absolutely!

I am deeply grateful and also have enormous respect for the team and the beautiful way everything was organized. Hats off to you all.

Peace Field truly feels like a home to come home to. A place to step away from everything for a while and, yes... you experience a sisterhood/brotherhood that heals.

Voilà...

Another big hug, and once again: Thank You and Namaste.
name: Emma B.

quote:
Dear organizing team and team, I would like to express my heartfelt thanks to you all for this special event, which you organized with such commitment and dedication. It was my first time at Peace Field, and I am still struck by the sense of sacredness that pervades this space.

A special thank-you to the facilitator for his explanations and for transmitting the State of Oneness, and last but not least to the Great Compassionate Light, which is our everything. On my journey home yesterday, and again today, I was filled with joy for no reason and a strong sense of connection to the Great Compassionate Light. Thank you so much for everything.
name: Georg F.

quote:
First of all, I would like to express my deepest gratitude to the Great Compassionate Light, Sri AmmaBhagavan, to the facilitator, the organizing team, the wonderful Peace Field team, and all the participants.

What a gift it was to participate in these wonderful one-to-one transfers with the facilitator. The energy and blessings flowing through him are immensely powerful. You can feel them throughout the hall and become part of the blessing even before sitting down in front of him.

These transfers are profoundly transformative. The mind becomes still, and there is only joy, presence, love, and laughter. During the third transfer in particular, I was completely taken over. When I tried to stand, I had lost control of my body, and the helpers placed me on another chair.

There was only deep silence—no thoughts, just lightness and complete contentment. There was no craving or desire, only a profound connection with everything and a sense of the incredible love of Sri AmmaBhagavan.

Since returning home, I notice more thoughts than ever before, yet there is stillness in the background. I simply notice and accept the thoughts as they come and go. My connection with Sri AmmaBhagavan feels more intense and vivid. I am at peace.

During the transfers, I also felt a much deeper connection with everyone present and immense joy that we were all able to receive this tremendous gift. What a blessing.
name: Geraldine T.

quote:
Thank you to everyone involved in organizing this event, especially the organizing leader. Not forgetting the service coordinator for setting up the group communications and keeping us informed ahead of the weekend.

The event organization was flawless. Every little detail was thought about to make it run smoothly. I am so grateful to each and every one of the team for their efforts.

I loved how the facilitator answered the questions and gave his explanations in the talk before the transfers. His responses were so simple and clear.

I did not have a big experience during the 1-on-1 transfer, but I know I have been affected by the energy. I got back home this evening and I was exhausted—a real sign that there is internal work going on.

I enjoyed having Darshan with the large group after the 1-on-1 transfers. I'm sure it intensified the energy. It was wonderful to see the spiritual guide looking so well. He radiated bright light during Darshan.

I hope everyone has a smooth return to normality after the transfer.
name: Ine Q.

quote:
On Friday afternoon, when smelling the Soma from the sacred chamber, I experienced it working strongly in my brain.

Before the 1-on-1 with the facilitator, there was occasionally a little wave of sadness that seemed to move through the field; it felt impersonal. During the 1-on-1, I immediately entered the peace and silence that I am.

On Saturday with the spiritual guide, I was still present as silence, even during the laughter. During the facilitator's transfers, I felt the greatly increased power. Sitting opposite him, I felt waves of warmth and love flowing into my abdomen and heart.

Gratitude for everything. To the Great Compassionate Light, the facilitator, the organizing team, the team, and everyone present.

And today my body is recovering: integration day.
name: Marian B.

quote:
My very first time at Peace Field—what an experience. I am so happy it finally happened! What a beautiful place, and what a harmonious team. I felt so grateful to witness it. Even the fragrance of the Soma surprised me, and I immediately noticed its effect on my brain. Thank you, organizing leader, for creating this place.

Then there was the facilitator—a phenomenon in himself. I had no idea what to expect; I only knew I had to go when I read the message. I registered before I even knew how I would travel without my own transport.

I was the very first participant. I saw the facilitator consume the Soma, and then the facilitator as a personality was gone. I was sitting opposite pure, ecstatic, exuberant Oneness. I remember thinking: am I going to have an opinion about this? No—I am going to experience it. And I did. Those thirty seconds felt very long, and I laughed so much. Back in my place, I felt the tension and burden of the previous months sliding away. My heart tingled, my head spun, and the laughter came in waves. Thank you, facilitator, for this unique experience.

The next day brought Darshan with Sri Bhagavan in a hall filled with members of the spiritual community. It felt like family and the energy was intense, yet I remained very alert.

Again and again, I caught a trace of the Soma fragrance even when no Soma was present.

During the second session with the facilitator, I understood more of his explanations and presentation and knew a little better what to expect. I set the intention to be completely open to the Divine. Again, I was first. I saw the facilitator take the Soma and witnessed the shift.

This one-to-one entered me very differently: I felt completely connected with the Great Compassionate Light, in Oneness. I was deeply moved and profoundly grateful. Tears kept flowing—sometimes silently, sometimes through laughter, sometimes as I looked around in wonder at the participants, the beautifully coordinated team, the facilitator, and the sacred altars. So much love.

On the way back to our accommodation, I could no longer speak coherently. My head felt heavy and soft at the same time. I am still joyful now, and I have much more energy than before the weekend. Thank you, Geel team—including the facilitator.
name: Sylvia J.

quote:
The Soma was absolutely delicious.

The 1-on-1 with the facilitator wasn't particularly special for me. There was a lot of movement in my body, but apart from that, I didn't experience any other sensations.

Last time, I experienced an enormous power. I had the feeling that with that power, anything could be accomplished—both good and bad.

The transmissions do bring about some changes, such as more joyful moments, occasionally becoming aware of the chatter in my head, and having more energy.

If the facilitator comes again without a Darshan immediately afterwards, I will come. I feel/know that it is important, whether or not I experience many sensations.

Thank you for everything.
name: Thomas L.

quote:
I was feeling a bit down, partly because of some difficult conversations with my teenage daughter, when I arrived on Friday. During the first session, a lot of energy flowed through me and all my worrying thoughts vanished. I really appreciated the facilitator's explanation. A few things really struck a chord with me, including the difference between cravings and wishes: with cravings, you absolutely must have it; with wishes, whatever is available is fine, even if a wish isn't fulfilled.

What I feel most of all is a new kind of surrender to the Divine. I think it's because of the energy and the explanation he gave. It's so clear that all I can do is ask for help and that I mustn't try to sort out the things I come across or want to achieve on my own anymore.

When I pray now, I also feel the energy flowing very strongly; it's very physical—I can feel my spiritual eye, I can feel things happening—and that's really lovely.

A deeper realization that I can't actually do anything myself, and that I don't need to do anything either.

Over the past few days, I've felt a much greater body awareness. When I walk on the heath near my house, I'm much more aware of my feet on the ground, the sound of my footsteps on the path, the wind brushing past my body.

Every now and then I feel waves of energy, of bliss, washing over me—it's so, so nice!

Thank you so much for this opportunity, dear organizing team, facilitator, and team.

I feel very privileged to be able to take part.

Much love!
name: Helena W.

quote:
I had not participated in a three-day course for a long time, yet I felt strongly drawn to this course on healing the inner child. I already knew the teachings from other courses, but this time they entered much more deeply.

During a rebirthing process at another location, I had thought that my birth-related issues had been resolved. During this three-day course, I saw that not everything had been healed. There was still a pattern of 'not being good enough', formed during my first six hours and my first six years. I saw how it had affected the rest of my life. This was a profound insight. I also recognized the same pattern in my mother: we had both been conditioned in this way.

During the one-to-one sessions with the facilitator at Peace Field, the energy was extremely high and increased with each session. In my service work, I remained very functional and efficient. I felt Divine energy flowing through me most of the time, had abundant energy, and experienced bliss flowing freely.

During Sri AmmaBhagavan's Darshan, we were asked to place our hands on our heads to receive a blessing. When I did this, it did not feel like my own head. It felt like another, much smaller head. Only the following night did I realize that it was the head of my inner child receiving the blessing. After the Darshan process, there was immense, immense bliss.

On Monday at work, I could feel that everything was still integrating, and I remained a little spaced out. The processes continue to deepen and unfold. There is seeing, listening, prayer, gratitude, and flowing with whatever is present.

In supreme gratitude, always at the lotus feet of the Great Compassionate Light, Sri AmmaBhagavan.
name: Ronald E.

quote:
Hey dear organizing team,

I'm not really sure what I experienced. It was overwhelming in the sense that there was so much movement and sound coming from the facilitator. At that moment, I really didn't know what to "think" of it or what to "do" with it. I may even have found it a little over the top, if I may say that carefully.

And when I sat in front of the facilitator myself, I didn't have the feeling that I felt anything at all.

Then it was time to get up, and my legs gave way. I couldn't stand on my own feet. That was very, very strange. At that moment, I also became quite emotional.

The lovely people from your team took me to the large window, where I could lie down and calm down, cry a little, and shake it out, or something like that.

What it will do for me, I don't know yet either. There has been too little time for me to reflect on it because of the busyness of the planned event weekend.

It was really so lovely to see people again after such a long time. With some people, it felt very genuine, and I had missed that—a little bit like coming home again after all.

I notice that I still don't have a clear overview of everything that is being offered—what happens when and in what way. I don't grasp it all immediately yet.

Thank you, dear organizing team.
name: Susanna K.

quote:
Dear organizing team,

My report:

Arriving at Peace Field, I felt really welcome—by the friendly service volunteers, by the organizing leader, by other people, and especially by the place itself. It was as if the energy of the place embraced me.

It felt very familiar and safe.

During the session, the energy of the group felt really nice—loving and open.

The first session with the facilitator was overwhelming for me. It felt as if a part of me was not there, withdrawn. After the session and during the break, I felt very tired.

The second session was different. I really loved hearing the facilitator's story and insights twice. It gave me deeper insight.

During the session with the facilitator, the expression of his life energy gave me so much permission to let myself go fully and express my joy, my life energy, without holding back. It was liberating. Something inside became free.

It felt as if I was now fully inhabiting my body. I was much more present. I felt happy and full of energy. The tiredness was completely gone.

During the days afterwards, there were moments when I could really feel: "These thoughts are not mine... no, not mine." That gave me space. Sometimes I was aware of the Field where everything becomes visible and appears.

One morning I woke up and felt that I was merging with the Field around me. I was disappearing. It felt wonderful—so much space, softness, and expansion. The facilitator said, "Melting, melting, melting like butter in the sun." That was what I was feeling in the merging with the Field.

My relationship with the Divine Feminine has deepened. I feel Her much closer to me, a deeper connection. I feel Her love, Her smile, Her embrace.

Something has been touched in me on a deep level. Therefore, I feel endlessly grateful and thankful.

Thanks to all the participants, to the service volunteers, to the organizing leader and facilitator, to the Great Compassionate Light and Sri AmmaBhagavan, and to the Universal Intelligence.
name: Marita B.

quote:
It is very difficult to put the experiences of Unity into words. I'll just give it a try.

Since the first transfer of the state from the facilitator, my own state has changed permanently.

In another location, years ago, I also occasionally had experiences of Unity.

At the deepest level, the Unity State is now permanently present.

In essence, everything is Oneness.

Nothing exists in itself anymore; everything is the Field or the Divine.

In that State of Unity, everything is quiet and thoughts are very short and functional.

When consciousness goes to that Unity, a huge energy is released, but after a few minutes it can escalate and I can no longer function.

Distraction is then necessary: eating, sleeping, or loud music.

In general, I need more rest and sleep now.

But during my work and actions, my body is involved and that goes fine.

Sometimes, with abstract work, I can't get my brain focused.

Sometimes this Unity is overshadowed because my brain or my mind wants to return to the "normal" situation of the past.

That is a big effort for them, and they give up pretty quickly.

Then it is back to the State of Unity.

Life is also very simple. I can do nothing else than be myself and follow my deepest feelings.

More practically, the following characteristics belong to this Unity State:

The teaching "I am not my body" has become reality.

So, in my experience, there are two separate entities:

The Self or the Field, and the body.

I experience that they both function separately.

The following practical experiences are part of this:

When walking: The body walks in front of the Self.

The Self sees something it could not see from the place where the body stands.

At work and when acting: The body does the work and the Self is a witness to it.

With other people, the Unity State feels like this:

I experience the essence of other people and of events as the same as what I am connected to:

The Source or the Field.

Everything comes from the Divine; there is no more separation.

Nothing is outside of me anymore.

My personal will is no longer present.

Sorry, on paper, I can't express it better than this: how this new State of Unity feels and what effects it has on my life.

With many thanks to dear facilitator and everyone who made these transfers possible.

It is a big leap in consciousness for us and the world that, as soon as possible, many people can live in this state.

That hope makes me immensely happy.
name: Michiel J.
